description: r0b0tlab's dual-GB10 vLLM serve of Poolside Laguna M.1 NVFP4 (225B total, 23B active, coding model): tensor parallel 2 over Ray (a single Spark runs out of memory during MoE init), FlashInfer-CUTLASS NVFP4 GEMM and MoE, nvfp4 KV cache, Poolside tool and reasoning parsers, eager execution. Upstream quick start: 8192 token context, 4 sequences, 0.82 memory utilization; it reports 11.4 tok/s at c=1 and 49 tok/s at c=8 with the nvfp4 KV cache (upstream claims, not measured here). Licences: model Apache-2.0 per its Hugging Face card; the upstream repository declares no licence file (information only). GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint. Absolute KV correction: 4,697,620,480 bytes per rank covers 4 simultaneous full-context requests at 8,192 tokens at the BF16 bound of 2 bytes per cached element, which also bounds the nvfp4 and fp8 layouts. The creator context is retained. A utilization-sized pool allocated 475,392 tokens (34.35 GiB per rank) and left the entrypoint Spark at the 16 GiB host memory guard floor on 2026-10-26. This is an offline estimate; physical acceptance remains pending.
title: Laguna M.1 NVFP4 vLLM dual Spark (r0b0tlab)
